issue.body:
Would be better use VarDumper instead of var_export in yii2/log/Target.php method getContextMessage to avoid problem with circular references (e.g. Bug #1783 ).

for example when var_export crashes on c.r. you are given message 

```
Not Found (#404): Unable to find debug data tagged with  .....
```
